steps.note: Vector at the forward table with no m08 history: why he came, the plain exit, then at the security office his copy gives the cupboard code once and why he knows it. A face-to-face wrong accusation from the post copy takes the plain 'Check it properly' reply.

said: I've read the map three times.
Someone has to read the paper. I'm good at paper.

notSaid: Someone has to read the paper.

picks: How do you know their code

said: That cupboard. Annex standard. They copied our lock and kept our master code.
Write this down. I'd only worry otherwise.
I audited the Citadel annex's locks for a year.
notSaid: Still here. Still useful, I hope.

said: If that's wrong, Netherton loses Vector till you can clear him. Sure?
Check it properly. Then say sorry properly.
Then I am a pair of hands short. Carry on.
notSaid: You've done this to me once.
